description:
Garrett O Bric Property Advisors are delighted to present this exceptionally spacious and bright two bed second floor apartment set within a gated community in the heart of Shankill Village with all amenities and services virtually on your doorstep. This wonderful home boasts almost 70 square metres of well designed accommodation with an abundance of natural light along with fabulous open aspect with views of a woodland setting. This sale provides a superb opportunity to acquire a stylish and comfortable home set in a sought after and well connected location with excellent public transport links close at hand. Having just undergone a complete refurbishment the property is presented for sale in turn key condition and is finished to a high specification throughout. The layout is both generous and practical, perfect for modern living, the open plan living, dining and kitchen is a standout space, beautifully proportioned and enhanced by a wonderful picture window overlooking the woodlands, bringing the outside inside while the kitchen has been upgraded with a stunning custom built fitted kitchen complete with high quality integrated appliances. This lively bustling village is home to an abundance of local shops plus Tesco and Lidl, schools and churches. The stunning Shanganagh Park is close at hand with its wonderful playing fields, soccer and GAA pitches plus a super playground. The sea is just a mile away providing opportunities for water sports and sea swimming. For commuters the area boasts excellent infrastructure with Dublin Bus, DART and mainline rail services all close at hand. This exceptional apartment offers the perfect blend of modern living, spacious accommodation and enviable convenience and early viewing is strongly recommended to appreciate all this home has to offer.

Accommodation

Foyer with post boxes and lift access to the first floor. 

Entrance Hallway 
Welcoming approach via a bright inviting hallway, here a walk in hotpress provides ample linen storage while a further storage area keeps the hallway clutter free. Wonderful warm oak laminate timber flooring flows seamlessly throughout the property adding to the sense of space and reflecting the light while been easily maintained. 

Kitchen Diner Living Room
9.2 x 3.1m 
This is a stand out living space drenched in natural light with ample room for designated cooking, dining and living room areas. A walk in box bay window provides the perfect space for your dining table. The kitchen area is truly special and is home to a brand new bespoke fitted kitchen in stunning sage green with brass fittings offering plenty of storage, the kitchen is complete with built in oven, hob and extractor fan, integrated fridge freezer and dishwasher, the splash back is tiled for ease of maintenance. 

Primary Bedroom 
4 x 2.7m 
Double bedroom with built in wardrobes providing excellent storage plus an ensuite shower room with sanitary in classic white paired with a corner shower with glazed screen door, the room is complete with attractive wall panelling and tiling. 

Bedroom No. 2
4.4 x 2.5m 
Again this double bedroom features a range of fitted wardrobes. 

Bathroom
This stylish bathroom features high quality sanitary ware in white including wc, wash hand basin with vanity unit below providing excellent storage, and a bath with shower facility above. The room features extensive tiling in a timeless black and white colour scheme. 

Outside: 
The complex is set in wonderful landscaped grounds with designated underground parking.
